title: delphinium gautieri
intro: Delphinium gautieri, commonly known as the Alpine Delphinium, is a perennial flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of the Mediterranean. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Delphinium gautieri are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help to ease coughs and congestion. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
